note: REBUILD-DESIGN-v2 §5.1. SOURCE is the immutable comparison oracle; it does not change when main moves. DEPLOYMENT is a separate, later-refreshed rollback baseline. A new comparison baseline is added only by a recorded decision in approved_rebaselines.

reference_wheel.package_files_digest_method: sha256 over sorted '<path>,sha256=<b64>' RECORD rows of codex_harness/ and zeus/
reference_wheel.build: uv build --wheel in the extracted archive; build backend hatchling 1.32.4 (the SOURCE build requirement 'hatchling' is unpinned, so the wheel sha256 is reported and the package-file digest is the enforced identity)
reference_wheel.record_note: The installed RECORD gains installer rows (INSTALLER, REQUESTED, direct_url.json, uv_cache.json), so drivers enforce the package-file digest, not the installed RECORD bytes.

deployment.note: Per-process DEPLOYMENT/rollback baseline (OA, managed Fleet runtime incl. its payload, HostDelivery controller, scheduled observers, monitor). Collected fresh at cutover preparation (§6 R0); not a prerequisite of S0 and never substituted by SOURCE.

target.status: S11 unit P: the promoted root distribution; SOURCE archived under reference/m7/

environments.reference_venv: $ZEUS_REBUILD_SCRATCH/venv-ref (local: /home/trevi/workspaces/zeus/scratch/zeus-rebuild-001/venv-ref), built from the SOURCE archive wheel and the SOURCE uv.lock runtime dependencies (uv export --frozen --no-dev)
environments.target_venv: .venv from uv.lock (uv sync --frozen at the repository root)
environments.separation: separate processes and interpreters; neither environment has a path to the other; R-O origin assertions in every driver and in the target conftest
environments.isolation: R-P: audit hook (parent and child interpreters via compare/guard/sitecustomize.py), fail-loud fake claude/codex/docker first on PATH, empty HOME/CODEX_HOME/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, credential-named variables removed by name, bwrap --unshare-net with tmpfs over credential directories where available
environments.production: no production endpoint, DSN, token or credential file is copied into the worktree or either environment

layout.implementation_owner: one Claude implementer (no duplicate owner; no other rebuild/rewrite worktree or branch existed at creation)
layout.rule: DESIGN-s11 §20.5 archive rule: every SOURCE path has its SOURCE bytes at the root path or at reference/m7/<path> (or is additions-only); every file under reference/ is reference/README.md or a reference/m7/<q> equal to SOURCE's <q>; no credential-shaped string in a changed path
layout.promoted_from: the two-tree layout (allowed_changed_paths target/, compare/, coverage/, docs/context/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/context/README.md, docs/design.md, .github/workflows/validation.yml, AGENTS.md)
